name: cpu-web
description: 中国药科大学学生便捷服务站点 — Web 前台 + 最小可用后端的 MVP 原型

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix voicehub
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix voicehub
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server && npm run db:migrate:cpu --prefix voicehub
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,voicehub -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run dev:cpu --prefix voicehub"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web && npm run build:cpu --prefix voicehub
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --prefix server && npm run type-check --prefix web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,voicehub -c blue,magenta "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start:cpu --prefix voicehub"
